publication.title: iPhone OS Research Atlas
publication.scope: iPhone OS 1.1.4 / 4A102 and 3.1.3 / 7E18; native PinePhone execution, distinct QEMU gates and offline next-target study
publication.provenance: Original editorial synthesis of private project notebooks and experiment reports, with reviewed capture images, selected source excerpts and their provenance. Firmware, storage images, complete run artifacts and the implementation repository are not included.
publication.author: Felipe Guilherme Sabino

record.title: The public source survey has a bounded negative result
record.method: Official distribution/tag/tree inspection and pinned community-source comparison
record.observation: No matching public XNU 933 ARM source was found in the inspected Apple release repositories. Nearby desktop XNU and later community ARM trees provide references but not verified replacements.
record.limits: This is a scoped survey result, not proof that no historical archive exists. A later source tree does not establish 4A102 binary compatibility.

records.access: Private project record; original material is not distributed

[…]

The earliest official Apple XNU tag found in this survey with both real `osfmk/arm` and `pexpert/arm` implementation trees is [`xnu-4570.1.46`](https://github.com/apple-oss-distributions/xnu/tree/xnu-4570.1.46), commit `76e12aa3ea3036173a61fa1081c3be890e626e79`. It includes [`config/MASTER.arm`](https://github.com/apple-oss-distributions/xnu/blob/xnu-4570.1.46/config/MASTER.arm), [`osfmk/conf/files.arm`](https://github.com/apple-oss-distributions/xnu/blob/xnu-4570.1.46/osfmk/conf/files.arm), [`pexpert/conf/files.arm`](https://github.com/apple-oss-distributions/xnu/blob/xnu-4570.1.46/pexpert/conf/files.arm), and the ARM make fragments. This is a genuine ARM32 source/build structure, but much later than 933.
